name: gifmate
description: Trade GIFs with your coding agent: it watches animated GIFs frame by frame and sends GIFs from GIPHY. MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI; plus a Claude Code plugin with an in-chat GIF tray.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.mjs src/anim-worker.mjs --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
